description: Screen a buyer or consignee against US export-control lists before selling or shipping. Matches a name against the official US Consolidated Screening List (11 lists incl. BIS Entity List, Denied Persons, ITAR Debarred, SDN). Returns no_match, possible_match, confirmed_match or unable_to_determine with confidence, sources and coverage_limitations. No EU/UK lists; not legal advice. Use when a deal may involve US-origin items or technology. $0.02 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: screen_export_control
